scope: Bounded reuse-first inventory for the six visible defect groups in tmp/geologist-current-runtime-review.json. Runtime and protected sources were not changed. Rejected RGB-checker candidates and the sub-native 1672x941 Geologist grotto remain excluded from production reuse.

method.search: Repository filenames and live callers were searched for sediment, soil, sand, stone, rock, fossil, crystal, mineral, geode, pan, grotto and cave candidates.
method.inspection: Plausible raster candidates were opened directly when supported. Dimensions, pixel mode and exact-byte SHA-256 were measured read-only. SVG candidates retain only code/source and run02-rendered evidence; no unrendered SVG visual score is invented.
method.license_rule: Every proposed reusable source has an existing ASSET_LICENSES.md record. A future derived asset must add its own modifications/source line.
method.conservative_boundary: A crystal texture is not a complete geode, kitchen cookware is not a geology pan, and a background below 2048x2048 per playable screen is not runtime authority.

defect_groups.visible_failure: Run02 cyan disks/bars read as pipe or circuit and lack banks, sediment and wet/dry material.
defect_groups.generation_gap: One clean-alpha or full-board painted geology workbed containing quiet layered stone/soil plus a matching wet channel material, authored to accept the existing path overlay without reducing route readability.
defect_groups.production_brief: Generate only the stone/soil bed and wet-channel material family. Keep interaction geometry and dots in code; require restrained texture, broad value bands, navy/plum edge vocabulary and no baked path that could diverge from gameplay.

defect_groups.visible_failure: Opaque rectangular dirt hides nearly everything and partial clearing exposes a thin strip; final fossil remains a flat icon.
defect_groups.generation_gap: A shaped painted sediment cover with local cleared variants and a higher-finish fossil/stone slab that preserves the exact silhouette and three assembly regions.
defect_groups.production_brief: Do not regenerate the brush. Produce sediment and fossil slab as separate clean-alpha layers so runtime clearing reveals local pixels instead of moving an opaque rectangle; verify partial states and brush-held contact.

defect_groups.visible_failure: Run02 pan is a flat shallow ellipse with weak material depth, sparse grit and generic small mineral polygons.
defect_groups.generation_gap: An isolated painted shallow geology pan plus separate sediment/water and three mineral reveal components with clean alpha and phone-readable size.
defect_groups.production_brief: Use geology-pan reference semantics, not Castle cookware. Keep pan, sediment and mineral layers separate for wash progression. The existing pan_attempt01 and six-prop attempts are RGB checkerboard and remain rejected; their pixels cannot be derived into runtime art without a separately authorized compliant process.

defect_groups.visible_failure: Closed oval reads as a capsule; seam taps do not create cracks; opened halves resemble doors and crystals are small/detached.
defect_groups.generation_gap: A matched clean-alpha closed/cracked/open geode shell set with one stable irregular stone identity and an integrated crystal cavity.
defect_groups.production_brief: Generate the shell state family as one bounded identity-continuity job. Existing crystal art may guide or texture the cavity but cannot substitute for shell topology. Require visible crack accumulation aligned to the five live seam spots.

defect_groups.visible_failure: Huge flat tan board and abstract polygon cave remain far below adjacent painted actor finish.
defect_groups.generation_gap: A compliant native 2048x2048-per-screen Geologist room/workbench master and restrained foreground/work-surface framing compatible with all four modes.
defect_groups.production_brief: One room composition must serve River, Fossil, Pan and Geode without painting state-specific objects into the background. The 1672x941 grotto and 2048x1024 training grotto are reference-only; neither is production authority.

defect_groups.visible_failure: Strong Geologist cutout remains in a narrow left strip and does not visibly handle central material in run02 stills.
feasible_existing_reuse: roshan_geologist_sheet_a.png held work cell 0 and other source-supported pose keys
defect_groups.production_brief: Attempt layout and phase-specific selection of an existing supported pose first, plus an object-bound hand/tool cue where necessary. Capture actual held contact. Commission a new actor pose only if mounted evidence proves every existing cell direction fails; never alter the approved atlas merely for novelty.

summary.no_generation_yet: This ledger defines bounded gaps only. No pixel generation, derived raster, production binding or acceptance occurred.
